line.text: Mako stands in the doorway, scanning your apartment like a building inspector with a grudge.
You're letting a plant die in the corner. That's not a style choice, that's a countdown.
And your posture. You sit like you're apologizing to the furniture.
Your snack shelf is a crime scene. Plain chips? No dip? This is why you lose things.
You came over just to insult my apartment?
I came over because the bet says I have to be nice. This is me being nice.
It's day twelve. I'm being nice. You're welcome.
Her tail flicks once, then goes still. She touches the chain at her throat.

choice.prompt: She's waiting for you to react.

options.text: You're right about the plant. I'll fix it.

reaction.text: Good. I wasn't going to say it twice.
Her ears rotate forward, tracking your face like she's checking for sarcasm.

options.text: So the bet is why you're here?

reaction.text: I'm fulfilling the terms. That's all this is.
She steps back half a pace and crosses her arms, tail curling tight around her ankle.

options.text: Your posture critique is rich coming from someone who's four-eleven.

reaction.text: Height isn't a posture problem. That's not even in the same category.
The corner of her mouth twitches up before she flattens it.

options.text: I appreciate you checking on me. Really.

reaction.text: I'm not checking on you. I'm critiquing. There's a difference.
She talks faster now, eyes on the plant instead of you.

desc: She critiques your apartment, your posture and your taste in snacks, all correct.
